proposals.text: Test whether requiring a minimum analogue-similarity score before validated-state entries improves net sealed-holdout expectancy versus the current gate. Use identical spreads, slippage, symbols, and time splits; accept only if net expectancy increases and trade count remains at least 70% of baseline. Record the experiment in `ExperimentRegistry` and retain the current champion unless every promotion gate passes.

question: The AEGIS MT5 DEMO bot is running the intelligent firehose with the validated-state gate. Given the current measured evidence, identify ONE concrete, falsifiable improvement candidate for the next research cycle. Do not modify code or the champion. Cite book corpus passages if relevant.
